excerpts.content: in the case of these validations what should be done if they are found to be invalid ?

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content:
0 returned on stack, nonce incremented, all creation gas consumed
(same as what EIP-3540 currently specifies for CREATE/CREATE2)
